profile.headline: Software Verification Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: Hampton Falls, New Hampshire, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
We are now Abbott !

Design Controls:       Requirements, verification, risk analysis, regulatory submission/questions.
Software:                  Test tools and automated test scripting written 'C' (Labview CVI, IAR), results imported into a test management tool (Integrity).
Verification:              Protocols, reports, defect tracking, team lead.
Root Cause Analysis:  CAPA, field complaints, hardware/software interface issues.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and Verification of Left Ventricular Assist Device and peripherals.

positions.title: Systems Engineer
positions.description:
* Systems Engineering for the surgical navigation system (capital equipment, sensors, and disposable tools).
* Complaint investigation.

positions.title: Integration Group Lead
positions.description:
* I was the integration lead (group of 4) for a Programmable Logic Controller.  Familiar with communication protocols used in the factory setting:  Modbus, CAN, Profibus, etc.
* Implemented automated testing using National Instrument's LabWindows CVI.

positions.title: Verification Engineer
positions.description: * Verification protocols for the external programmer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
*  Wrote embedded software for a heart-lung machine.  The design was distributed using Echelon as the communiction protocol.  I was responsible for the IO which included sensors and actuators.  
*  Prototyping using CAN as the communcation protocol.

positions.title: Software Engineer / Verification Engineer
positions.description:
* Wrote automated verification tests for the implanted defibrillator.
* Maintained the database task for the external programmer (QNX OS).

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
*  Hardware design (primarily digital).
*  Embedded software ('C' and assembly)
*  Proprietary operating systems and distributed designs.
